headline: Board Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: Ball Corporation's (NYSE: BALL) board of directors (the "Board") today declared a cash dividend of 20 cents per share, payable September 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 1, 2026.

headline: Silgan Holdings (SLGN) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
summary: Silgan (SLGN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.08% and +1.54%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
